title: Multi-cell candidate portfolio contract (L4)
description: Top-K cell selection for portfolio routing. See ADR-039.

invariants.name: sorted_descending
invariants.description: Result list sorted by confidence DESC. First element matches legacy select_origin_cell.

invariants.name: confidence_clamped
must: value outside range rejected at construction

invariants.name: matched_selectors_transparent
invariants.description: Each candidate has matched_selectors tuple listing exact selector strings.
must: matched_selectors is a tuple of str
operator can use for debug audit
empty tuple allowed when no selector matched (e.g., default-fallback cell)

invariants.name: slots_dataclass
invariants.description: CellCandidate uses @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True) per L60-NEW pattern.

invariants.name: backward_compat_select_origin_cell
invariants.description: Existing select_origin_cell(query) remains, returns top_k(query, k=1)[0].cell_id or None.
must: no breaking change to existing select_origin_cell API
implementation can delegate to top_k internally
None returned when no candidates exist

invariants.name: empty_result_semantics
invariants.description: When no cell matches, return EMPTY LIST (not None).

out_of_scope: Verifier/ensemble logic consuming the portfolio (separate ADR)
Portfolio caching for repeat queries (separate ADR)
